title: rebutia pygmaea
intro: Rebutia pygmaea, commonly known as the Pygmy Rebutia or Little Ball, is a species of flowering plant in the cactus family (Cactaceae). This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rebutia pygmaea include its possible use in treating various health conditions, such as fever reduction and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
